name: brand-ai-readiness-audit
description: Audits any website for AI-discoverability and on-site-engagement problems and emits a single prioritized, evidence-backed findings report. Read-only and recommend-only: never modifies the audited site.

skills.description: Entrypoint. Takes the target URL, runs every specialist skill, de-duplicates and severity-ranks their findings, adds proactive recommendations, and emits the single audit report.
Layer 1 - can a machine reach and read the page at all? robots.txt, status codes, redirects, sitemap, AI-crawler blocks, JS-render dependency.
Once a visitor arrives - orientation, navigation depth, next-step affordances, context retention across pages.
